channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Modern, light-filled Minneapolis house on Lake Harriet lists for $5M
item.description: Renowned Wayzata and Deephaven-based architect Charles Stinson designed the 6,893-square-foot property in 2003.

item.title: Anderson: Doomed to a cold, watery death, three hunters were awash in the Mississippi River until being rescued
item.description: Caught in a maelstrom, their boat swamped and they bobbed amid whitecaps.

item.title: Jamie Nelson has hat trick as Gophers women’s hockey routs St. Cloud State 8-1
item.description: Sydney Morrow added four assists and surpassed 100 points for her college career.

item.title: Witnesses dispute DHS claim that 5-year-old was ‘abandoned’ prior to ICE detainment
item.description: City and school leaders in Columbia Heights witnessed the preschooler being detained by federal agents, and say the boy could’ve been released to other adults on scene.

item.title: Suspect in little girl’s abduction was at her bus stop a day earlier, too, charges say
item.description: Joseph A. Bragg, 28, charged with kidnapping and first-degree criminal sexual conduct, was a stranger who had “sought us out for a while,” the girl’s mother said.

item.title: Activists released from custody after arrests tied to church service disruption
item.description: Nekima Levy Armstrong, Chauntyll Allen and William Kelly are accused of violating the federal FACE Act.

item.title: Two women, detained by ICE, say they helped agent having seizure
item.description: The women say they guided agents through the emergency, later raising concerns about medical protocols, weapons safety and accountability.

item.title: FBI agent who tried to investigate ICE officer in Renee Good shooting resigns
item.description: She reportedly left her job after bureau leadership pressured her to discontinue a civil rights inquiry into ICE agent Jonathan Ross.

item.title: Agents detain and send 2-year-old girl and her father to Texas despite court order to release toddler
item.description: Attorneys for the family say they were asylum-seekers who were pulled over without a warrant. The girl has been reunited with her mother.

item.title: The latest: Thousands march, scores of Minnesota businesses close to protest ICE operation
item.description: Shops, restaurants, museums, nonprofits closed as part of a statewide demonstration. Despite the frigid weather, a large crowd of protesters gathered in downtown Minneapolis.
